nodes.name: .mcp.json
nodes.summary: Project-level MCP server configuration registering context7, mcpvault, smart-connections, a read-only Neo4j bridge (bolt://127.0.0.1:7688), and a Postgres server for the layer-3 trading engine sessions.
nodes.languageNotes: Neo4j entry pins NEO4J_READ_ONLY=true and uses 127.0.0.1 (not localhost) to avoid the IPv6 stall documented in project memory.

nodes.name: ADMISSION_INPUT_HARDENING_prompt.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code task prompt for hardening admission inputs via a deterministic computed cooldown guard and an additive live operational-status feed adapter, with combined determinism/replay and governance writeback steps.

nodes.name: ADR-011_drafting_prompt.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code prompt directing the authoring of ADR-011 (Execution / Portfolio Layer Planning) with governance grounding and a governance-only writeback slice.

nodes.name: ADR-011_promote_and_plan_prompt.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code prompt to promote ADR-011 to active status and author its implementation plan as a STEP-0 brief without yet producing nodes or code.

nodes.name: CHAIN_ORCHESTRATOR_RUNBOOK.md
nodes.summary: Operations runbook for the end-to-end chain orchestrator covering data flow, the full replay key and determinism guarantees, captured operational status, invocation, daily scheduling, and corpus provenance.

nodes.name: CHAIN_ORCHESTRATOR_prompt.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code prompt for building the end-to-end chain orchestrator integration slice, including a full-chain replay benchmark, governance writeback, and explicit out-of-scope follow-ups.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md

nodes.name: EPOCH_B_CALIBRATION_RUNBOOK.md
nodes.summary: Empirical calibration runbook for epoch (b) defining the version axis, pinned baseline, corpus-sufficiency assessment, the empirical-readiness gate, and the recalibrate-validate-re-pin loop with PIT invariants.

nodes.name: EPOCH_B_CALIBRATION_prompt.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code prompt for epoch (b) empirical recalibration: read-only corpus sufficiency assessment, authoring calibration governance, and conditionally executing calibration only when the sufficiency gate passes.

nodes.name: EPOCH_B_CORPUS_RUNBOOK.md
nodes.summary: Real-corpus accumulation runbook for epoch (b) describing the content-id-keyed immutable sinks, the automated daily scheduled task, manual operation, snapshot verification through the Layer-3 chain, and PIT/data-quality notes.

nodes.name: EXECUTION_LAYER_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Detailed implementation plan for the execution layer that closes ADR-011 gates (a-f), settles contract-checkpoint design decisions, and sequences contract-first authoring, code slices, tests, and per-slice writeback.

nodes.name: FOLLOWUPS_cooldown_and_operational_feed_prompts.md
nodes.summary: Two paired Claude Code follow-up prompts for the orchestrator: a computed cooldown guard and a live operational-status feed adapter constrained to the IO boundary with replay-path quarantine.

nodes.name: FORWARD_RETURN_HARNESS_prompt.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code prompt for building a deterministic, read-only forward-return labeling harness (ADR-012 gate G3 prerequisite) with strict look-ahead containment and synthetic correctness validation.

nodes.name: GOLD_CONFIDENCE_IMPLEMENTATION_BRIEF.md
nodes.summary: Implementation brief for the gold-confidence feature documenting affected modules and schemas, ontology and replay impact, benchmark and migration risk, and the verification summary.

nodes.name: GOLD_DECISIONPACKET_V0_BRIEF.md
nodes.summary: Implementation brief for the gold DecisionPacket v0 covering affected modules/schemas, the regime-to-direction mapping design decision, canonical-id re-derivation, and a strict contract-first execution order.

nodes.name: GOLD_DECISIONPACKET_V0_FINAL_AUDIT.md
nodes.summary: Final audit of the gold DecisionPacket v0 scoring architecture, replay determinism, ontology and ADR compliance, schema correctness, and graph integrity, with critical issues, warnings, and a readiness verdict.

nodes.name: JARVIS_el_nino_integration_and_refactor_roadmap.md
nodes.summary: Integration and refactor roadmap for connecting the JARVIS console to the operational dev_graph (Neo4j + read-only neo4j MCP), replacing its keyword KB with graph-grounded answering, and refactoring the HTML monolith to React.

nodes.name: OPS_DASHBOARD_prompt.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code prompt for the El Nino operations dashboard (JARVIS control plane) defining overriding safety constraints, read-only monitoring IA, safe actions, gated-live actions behind a hard pause, and writeback.

nodes.name: OPS_TUI_prompt.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code prompt for the El Nino operations console terminal TUI defining a governed ops-core, a read-only TUI, safe and gated-live actions behind a hard pause, and tests plus writeback.

nodes.name: PAPER_TRADING_RUNTIME_FINAL_AUDIT.md
